name: single_kernel_fused_swiglu_backward
boundary: saved intermediate and grad_output to grad_intermediate only
hypothesis: One CUDA kernel removes multi-kernel elementwise overhead while preserving FP16 intermediate operations and exact inverse packing.
optimization: Fuse sigmoid, SiLU, derivative, offset addition, products, and [grad_gate, grad_up] stores into one current-stream launch.
assumptions: intermediate, grad_output, and grad_intermediate are contiguous FP16 tensors
intermediate packs gate in the first width/2 values and up in the second width/2 values per row
